comment: Deterministic red-approach replay for the geometric red-light pre-deceleration (pattern ported from navipilot traffic_control route fixtures). Frames drive SignalStopPrepare + PrepareArbitrator on a fixed timeline: confirm 4 frames over 0.6 s, hold an unchanged observation through the controller's freshness window (grace), a long dropout that resets, re-confirmation, another dropout, then driver-gas override (10 s controller cooldown) at the end. kind=red publishes a fresh housing-confirmed red track; kind=repeat replays the last published observation (the planner can read faster than the shadow publishes); kind=gas adds driver throttle input.

arbitrator.comment: Expected PrepareArbitrator cap state at the same timeline (mode 2, clear radar; envelope ~49 m at 12 m/s stays under the 60 m near bound so no escalation)
